ground_truth.description: Storage key derivation allows collisions between Counts and Snapshot structs when token addresses have specific properties.
ground_truth.root_cause: Storage key derivation allows collisions between Counts and Snapshot structs when token addresses have specific properties.
ground_truth.fix_description: Use distinct storage namespaces or add type discriminators to storage key derivation.
